headline: Qatar Becomes Largest Buyer of US LNG Amid Hormuz Crisis
summary: Qatar, previously the world's second-largest LNG exporter, has become the biggest buyer of liquefied natural gas from the United States following the Iran war and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz.
why: Qatar is a major global exporter of liquefied natural gas, while the United States is the top LNG producer, making this shift in trade flows a significant development for global energy markets.

impacts.name: US LNG
impacts.why: The closure of the Strait of Hormuz and the Iran war disrupted Qatari exports and redirected trade flows, significantly increasing Qatari purchases of US liquefied natural gas.
